activity-qualifier.description: The reported uniqueQualifier from the native activity ID, stored as text to retain all digits.

activity-time.description: The activity timestamp in UTC with up to microsecond precision.

activity-time-raw.description: The exact time field from the native activity ID, including its original precision and offset.

actor-email.description: The actor email reported by Google Workspace. The field can also contain a placeholder.

actor-key.description: The reported actor key, which may identify an OAuth requester or a robot account.

actor-profile-id.description: The reported Google Workspace actor profile identifier. The field can also contain a placeholder.

application-name.description: The Google Workspace Reports API application from the native activity ID.

customer-id.description: The Workspace customer identifier from the native activity ID.

ip-src.description: The reported source address when it is a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.

oauth-application-name.description: The name of the application used to perform the activity, when reported by Google.

oauth-client-id.description: The OAuth client ID of the application used to perform the activity.

owner-domain.description: The resource owner domain reported for this activity.

source-address.description: The original ipAddress field from the activity, including any provider label or redaction.

description: An activity from the Google Workspace Reports API with its native compound ID, actor and source context.
name: google-workspace-audit-activity
